sections.content: Contrast past and present with antes, en aquella época, actualmente, hoy en día, todavía and ya. Use imperfecto for past situations and present or present perfect for current states and changes.

items.spanish: Antes, la comunicación era más lenta.
En aquella época, muchas personas no tenían acceso a Internet.
items.english: At that time, many people did not have access to the Internet.

items.spanish: En comparación con antes, la vida ha cambiado mucho.
items.english: Compared with before, life has changed a lot.

sections.content: Use a clear time marker so the listener knows which period you are describing.
